tools.name: search_uet_taxila
tools.description: Use this when a user asks about UET Taxila (University of Engineering and Technology, Taxila) and the other UETGPT tools don't cover it: admission schedule and deadlines, documents, quotas and seats, hostels, transport, scholarships, academic rules, departments or campus life. Returns passages and s

tools.name: list_uet_programs
tools.description: Use this when a user asks which undergraduate programs UET Taxila offers, or wants to compare UET Taxila programs by recent closing merit or HSSC requirement. Returns each program's degree type, duration, minimum HSSC percentage and latest published Category A closing merit with its year. Do not use

tools.name: get_uet_program
tools.description: Use this when a user asks about one UET Taxila undergraduate program: its credit hours, duration, accreditation body, minimum HSSC percentage or closing merit history for 2022-2024. Do not use it for listing all programs or for programs at other universities.

tools.name: calculate_merit_aggregate
tools.description: Use this when a user gives their SSC (matric), HSSC Part-I (FSc first year) and entry test (ECAT/TCAT) marks and wants their UET Taxila merit aggregate, eligibility, or which programs they might get. Applies the official 17% SSC + 50% HSSC Part-I + 33% entry test formula. Ask for any missing marks;

tools.name: estimate_uet_fees
tools.description: Use this when a user asks what UET Taxila undergraduate admission costs: tuition per semester, admission charges, first-semester total, hostel charges, or application and entry test fees. Figures come from the official prospectus and FAQs with their source URLs. Do not use it for other universities

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "calculate_merit_aggregate" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
